court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Arahat Bhaskar (Minor) And Another v. State Of U.P. And 3 Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Arahat Bhaskar (Minor), Vandana Maurya (mother and guardian)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P., Shailendra Kumar Singh, Superintendent of Police, Jhansi, Station House Office, Police Station Kotwali, District-Jhansi

facts_of_case: Petitioner's mother was married to respondent no. 4, but they had a dispute and the mother filed cases against him. She also claimed protection from her husband who allegedly threatened her life.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the best interests of the child while deciding custody.
legal_principles.held: In the instant petition, question for dispute of custody of corpus 'Arahat Bhaskar' (minor), aged about 7 years is involved.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 6
Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 13
cited_cases: Basudha Sethi & Ors. vs. Kiran V. Bhaskar & Anr., (2022) SC 24
Rohith Thammana Gowda vs. State of Karnataka & Ors., (2022) Live Law (SC) 643, Civil Appeal No. 4987 of 2022

outcome.final_order: The court directed the Superintendent of Police to produce the minor before the court and set up his liberty.

use_for_drafting: drafting habeas corpus petition for minor's custody
seeking protective custody for minor in family court
obtaining judicial custody for minor in district court
